b_01M0X4EJBFG9QH83YC4T1Q13X7.subject: bathroom_remodel_standard_checklist
b_01M0X4EJBFG9QH83YC4T1Q13X7.content: This job_definition governs bathroom remodels, which follow a fixed 4-8 week shape (demo → rough MEP → tile/waterproofing → fixtures/finish) with permit pull always and tile/fixture selections locked before demo. These are non-negotiable prerequisites, not optional guidance.
b_01M0X4EJBFG9QH83YC4T1Q13X7.falsification_test: A signed bathroom remodel job that starts demo before material selections are finalized, or skips a permit, would falsify this.
